{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Here at R'dawc Bodyguard Agency we specialize in close quarter protection. If you think that you have what it takes to put your own body between a laser blast and your client, at the same time you're putting a armed assailant in the nearest hospital bay, then this is for you!|[[Peawp R'dawc]], to a brawler|<ref name="SWG:RBA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=class|Brawler|R'dawc Bodyguard Agency|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''R'dawc Bodyguard Agency''' was a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] agency founded by the [[Unarmed combat/Legends|melee combat]] expert [[Peawp R'dawc]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was based in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], clients included [[Otwi Opawl]], [[Walter Orvett]] and [[Tobo]].<ref name="SWG:RBA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The R'dawc Bodyguard Agency appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RBA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The R'dawc Bodyguard Agency was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 17 Notes for 26 May 2005|Publish 17]]," on [[May 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> It was involved in the quests given by Peawp R'dawc to beginner players who had chosen a "[[W:c:swg:Brawler|brawler]]" career.<ref name="SWG:RBA" /> The "brawler" profession was later removed from the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:2005" /> Peawp R'dawc's questline was widely revamped to be available for every new players and the R'dawc Bodyguard Agency was removed from these quests.<ref name="SWG:HHE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Hoodlums, Hoodlums Everywhere|Tatooine}}</ref>
